prompt: Sitting in the theatre lobby, we wondered why the evening play (still / not / to schedule) on the board.
explanation_ru: В отрицании Past Perfect Passive наречие still ставится либо сразу после had (had still not been scheduled), либо перед стяжённой формой (still hadn't been scheduled).

prompt: Poor Cora feels upset because her heavy birthday box (might / not / to lift) onto today's mail van.
explanation_ru: Предположение о том, что действие в прошлом могло не произойти, в пассиве строится по схеме might not have been + V3: might not have been lifted.

prompt: Heavy rain flooded the forest path, so why ___ before the school bus left?
options: hadn't the museum trip been postponed
hadn't been the museum trip postponed
the museum trip hadn't been postponed
wasn't been the museum trip postponed
explanation_ru: В отрицательном вопросе Past Perfect Passive перед подлежащим выносится только первый вспомогательный глагол hadn't, а been остаётся перед смысловым причастием: hadn't the museum trip been postponed.

prompt: Excited about our fitness club's bright new look, I asked, "Has the main hall (already / to repaint)?"
explanation_ru: В вопросе Present Perfect Passive после Has и подлежащего наречие already ставится перед been + V3: already been repainted.

prompt: Dale stares at the empty folder because the monthly sales charts (still / not / to upload).
explanation_ru: В отрицании Present Perfect Passive для множественного числа (charts) наречие still ставится после have (have still not been uploaded) или перед haven't.

prompt: Looking over your island ferry plan, ___ by a local guide before you board?
options: will your group be greeted
will be your group greeted
will your group greeted
is your group been greeted
explanation_ru: В вопросе Future Simple Passive вспомогательный глагол will ставится перед подлежащим your group, а be + V3 — после него: will your group be greeted.

prompt: Erin noticed her map app was slow because the latest street data (not / to update) yet.
explanation_ru: Повествование в прошлом (noticed, was) и слово yet требуют отрицания в Past Perfect Passive: had not been updated.

prompt: Standing near the fruit counter, Gabe asked why weren't the heavy boxes being lifted onto the shelf.
answer: Standing near the fruit counter, Gabe asked why the heavy boxes weren't being lifted onto the shelf.
accepted_answers: Standing near the fruit counter, Gabe asked why the heavy boxes weren't being lifted onto the shelf.
Standing near the fruit counter, Gabe asked why the heavy boxes were not being lifted onto the shelf.
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе после why сохраняется прямой порядок слов (подлежащее перед сказуемым): why the heavy boxes weren't being lifted...

prompt: Torn coat pockets (will / not / to mend) for free unless customers show a paper receipt.
explanation_ru: Отрицание в Future Simple Passive строится по схеме will not + be + V3: will not be mended.

prompt: Smiling warmly, Inez asked the station clerk, "___ for finding that lost wallet?"
options: Won't the honest bus driver be rewarded
Won't be the honest bus driver rewarded
Won't the honest bus driver rewarded
Isn't been the honest bus driver rewarded
explanation_ru: В отрицательном вопросе Future Simple Passive перед подлежащим ставится Won't, а конструкция be + V3 следует после подлежащего: Won't the honest bus driver be rewarded.

prompt: Walking into the kitchen, I wondered why ___ into the tall glass mugs yet.
options: the hot tea hadn't been poured
hadn't the hot tea been poured
the hot tea hadn't poured been
wasn't been poured the hot tea
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе (I wondered why...) используется прямой порядок слов (подлежащее the hot tea перед глаголом): the hot tea hadn't been poured.

prompt: Jana looked at the counter and asked, "Why (those fresh apple cakes / not / to slice) yet?"

blanks.cue: those fresh apple cakes / not / to slice
blanks.answer: haven't those fresh apple cakes been sliced
accepted_answers: haven't those fresh apple cakes been sliced
have those fresh apple cakes not been sliced

explanation_ru: В отрицательном вопросе Present Perfect Passive при стяжении haven't ставится перед подлежащим, а при полной форме not идёт после подлежащего: haven't those fresh apple cakes been sliced.

prompt: Checking our restaurant bill, we noticed that the extra bread basket (should / not / to count).
explanation_ru: Критика неверного действия в прошлом в пассивном залоге передаётся формой should not have been + V3: should not have been counted.

prompt: Kyle frowned at his desk and asked why hadn't been the science homework graded yet.
answer: Kyle frowned at his desk and asked why the science homework hadn't been graded yet.
accepted_answers: Kyle frowned at his desk and asked why the science homework hadn't been graded yet.
Kyle frowned at his desk and asked why the science homework had not been graded yet.
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе после why подлежащее должно стоять перед вспомогательным глаголом: why the science homework hadn't been graded yet.

prompt: Brightly painted guest rooms are ready, so ___ for the summer season yet?
options: haven't the garden balconies been repainted
haven't been the garden balconies repainted
aren't been the garden balconies repainted
haven't the garden balconies repainting
explanation_ru: В отрицательном вопросе Present Perfect Passive перед подлежащим выносится только первый вспомогательный глагол haven't, а been остаётся перед причастием: haven't the garden balconies been repainted.

prompt: Quick note: the weekend camping trip (still / not / to plan) because two friends are away.
explanation_ru: В отрицании Present Perfect Passive наречие still ставится сразу после has (has still not been planned) или перед стяжённой формой (still hasn't been planned).

prompt: Relax, Lana—you (will / not / to fine) for paying your small card bill one day late.
explanation_ru: Отрицание в Future Simple Passive строится по модели will not + be + V3: will not be fined.

prompt: Feeling better after my visit today, I asked the doctor, "Can our kind nurse (to reward) with a thank-you card?"
explanation_ru: В модальном вопросе пассивного залога после Can и подлежащего ставится be + третья форма глагола: be rewarded.

prompt: Spring flowers look lovely now, and hasn't the new children's play area (just / to fence) safely?
explanation_ru: В вопросе Present Perfect Passive после hasn't и подлежащего наречие just ставится перед been + V3: just been fenced.

prompt: Disappointed with the slow shop, I noticed my refund still isn't been credited to my account.
answer: Disappointed with the slow shop, I noticed my refund still hadn't been credited to my account.
accepted_answers: Disappointed with the slow shop, I noticed my refund still hadn't been credited to my account.
Disappointed with the slow shop, I noticed my refund still had not been credited to my account.
Disappointed with the slow shop, I noticed my refund still hasn't been credited to my account.
explanation_ru: С причастием been и наречием still нельзя использовать глагол isn't; для результата к моменту в прошлом нужен Past Perfect Passive: still hadn't been credited.
